title: Wait for the Gate
description:
Guestbook used to race its dependency and crash on a cold start.

Add an **init container** that prepares a volume or waits until the dependency is ready. The app container must not start until init succeeds — that gate is the whole point.

**Meant for:** Init containers.

problemStatement.brief: Add an init container that prepares a volume or waits on a dependency before Guestbook’s app container starts.
